rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The decree fixes the symbols of presidential power (the Standard, the Sign of the President and a specially made copy of the Constitution) and their use when a newly elected President assumes office: the President takes the oath on the special copy of the Constitution; the Chairman of the Federation Council places the Sign on him; after the oath a duplicate Standard is raised over the Kremlin residence; the symbols are handed over after the oath. In force from signature; signed by Yeltsin as President, 5 August 1996.
